title.zh: 词元 ID 代表什么

prompt.en: Leon's tokenizer gives "kite" the ID 812 and "red" the ID 4. Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh: Leon 的分词器给「kite」分配的 ID 是 812，给「red」分配的 ID 是 4。下列哪项说法正确？

text.en: The IDs are lookup addresses. The embedding row that each ID selects, which training adjusts, carries the useful numbers.
text.zh: ID 只是查表用的地址。真正承载有用数值的，是每个 ID 选中的那一行嵌入，而训练会调整这些嵌入。

why.en: Right. An ID says which row of the embedding table to read. Its size has no meaning.
why.zh: 正确。ID 只说明读取嵌入表的哪一行，它的大小没有任何含义。

text.en: kite carries about 200 times more meaning than red, because 812 / 4 = 203.
text.zh: kite 的含义大约是 red 的 200 倍，因为 812 / 4 = 203。

why.en: Wrong. ID 812 is not "more" than ID 4 in any sense; the numbers are like seat numbers.
why.zh: 错误。ID 812 在任何意义上都不比 ID 4「更多」；这些数字就像座位号。

text.en: The average of the IDs, (812 + 4) / 2 = 408, is a sensible vector for "red kite".
text.zh: 两个 ID 的平均值 (812 + 4) / 2 = 408 可以合理地表示「red kite」。

why.en: Wrong. Averaging addresses gives the address of an unrelated token. Average the embedding vectors instead.
why.zh: 错误。对地址取平均，得到的是一个毫不相关的词元的地址。应该对嵌入向量取平均。

text.en: Tokens with neighbouring IDs, such as 811 and 812, must have similar meanings.
text.zh: ID 相邻的词元，例如 811 和 812，含义一定相近。

why.en: Wrong. The tokenizer's numbering does not follow meaning. Similarity comes from the learned vectors.
why.zh: 错误。分词器的编号并不按含义排列。相似性来自学到的向量。

title.en: Same length is not the same space
title.zh: 长度相同不等于同一空间

prompt.en: Iris has an image encoder and a text encoder that were trained separately, on unrelated tasks. Both happen to output 512 numbers. She computes the cosine similarity between a photo's vector and a caption's vector and gets 0.71. Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh: Iris 有一个图像编码器和一个文本编码器，二者在互不相关的任务上分别训练。它们恰好都输出 512 个数。她计算一张照片的向量与一条说明文字的向量之间的余弦相似度，得到 0.71。下列哪项说法正确？

text.en: The score means little: nothing made coordinate j of the image vector describe the same thing as coordinate j of the text vector. The encoders must first be trained to align, for example on matched image–text pairs.
text.zh: 这个分数几乎没有意义：没有任何机制让图像向量的第 j 个坐标与文本向量的第 j 个坐标描述同一件事。必须先训练两个编码器使它们对齐，例如使用配对的图像–文本数据。

why.en: Right. Alignment is learned. Equal length is a requirement for the arithmetic, not evidence of compatible meaning.
why.zh: 正确。对齐是学出来的。长度相同只是进行运算的前提，并不说明含义相互兼容。

text.en: Because both vectors have 512 entries, they live in the same space, so 0.71 is a valid match score.
text.zh: 因为两个向量都有 512 个元素，它们处在同一个空间中，所以 0.71 是有效的匹配分数。

why.en: Wrong. Matching list lengths is not enough; the coordinates must acquire compatible meanings through training.
why.zh: 错误。列表长度相同还不够；坐标必须通过训练获得相互兼容的含义。

text.en: Normalising both vectors to length 1 makes them aligned.
text.zh: 把两个向量都归一化到长度 1，就能让它们对齐。

why.en: Wrong. Normalising removes overall size only. It cannot give unrelated coordinates a shared meaning.
why.zh: 错误。归一化只去掉整体大小，无法让毫不相关的坐标获得共同的含义。

text.en: 0.71 means the caption is about 71% likely to be correct.
text.zh: 0.71 表示说明文字大约有 71% 的可能是正确的。

why.en: Wrong. Cosine similarity is not a probability, even for aligned encoders, and here the encoders are not aligned at all.
why.zh: 错误。即使编码器已经对齐，余弦相似度也不是概率；何况这里的编码器根本没有对齐。

title.en: Late fusion with a missing modality
title.zh: 缺少一种模态时的后期融合

prompt.en: Noah's late-fusion system combines three scores with weights image 0.6, audio 0.3 and text 0.1. For one clip the image score is 0.7 and the text score is 0.2, but the audio is missing because the microphone failed. He renormalises the weights over the available modalities. What is the combined score? Give 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh: Noah 的后期融合系统用权重 图像 0.6、音频 0.3、文本 0.1 组合三个分数。某个片段的图像分数是 0.7，文本分数是 0.2，但由于麦克风故障，音频缺失。他在可用的模态上重新归一化权重。组合后的分数是多少？保留 3 位小数。

solution.en:
Step 1: available weights are image 0.6 and text 0.1, total 0.7.

Step 2: weighted sum = 0.6 × 0.7 + 0.1 × 0.2 = 0.42 + 0.02 = 0.44.

Step 3: renormalise: 0.44 / 0.7 ≈ 0.629. (Equivalently the weights become 6/7 and 1/7.)

If the missing audio were treated as a score of 0, the result would be 0.44: the microphone fault would quietly count as evidence against the label. Keep the separate scores too, because the image and text disagree here and a person may want to see that.
solution.zh:
第 1 步：可用的权重是图像 0.6 和文本 0.1，合计 0.7。

第 2 步：加权和 = 0.6 × 0.7 + 0.1 × 0.2 = 0.42 + 0.02 = 0.44。

第 3 步：重新归一化：0.44 / 0.7 ≈ 0.629。（相当于权重变成 6/7 和 1/7。）

如果把缺失的音频当作分数 0，结果会是 0.44：麦克风故障就会悄悄地被当作否定该标签的证据。也要保留各自的分数，因为这里图像和文本的结论不一致，人可能需要看到这一点。

title.zh: 只改采样率标签的后果

prompt.en: Emma has a 3-second mono recording sampled at 44,100 samples per second. A script changes the file's sample-rate label to 22,050 without resampling the samples. What duration, in seconds, will a player now report?
prompt.zh: Emma 有一段 3 秒的单声道录音，采样率为每秒 44,100 个样本。某个脚本把文件的采样率标签改成了 22,050，却没有对样本做重采样。播放器现在会报告多长的时长（秒）？

solution.en:
Step 1: sample count = 44,100 × 3 = 132,300 samples. Relabelling does not change this count.

Step 2: reported duration = sample count / labelled rate = 132,300 / 22,050 = 6 seconds.

The recording now claims to be twice as long, and every sound plays at half speed and an octave lower. Proper resampling to 16,000 samples per second would instead produce 16,000 × 3 = 48,000 new samples and keep the duration at 3 seconds. Any timestamp or audio–text match computed from the relabelled file would be wrong by a factor of two.
solution.zh:
第 1 步：样本数 = 44,100 × 3 = 132,300 个。改标签不会改变这个数。

第 2 步：报告的时长 = 样本数 / 标签上的采样率 = 132,300 / 22,050 = 6 秒。

录音现在自称长了一倍，每个声音都以一半的速度、低一个八度播放。正确地重采样到每秒 16,000 个样本，会得到 16,000 × 3 = 48,000 个新样本，时长仍保持 3 秒。从改了标签的文件计算出的任何时间戳或音频–文本匹配，都会差两倍。

title.zh: 更小的温度会带来什么

prompt.en: In a CLIP-style batch, one image's cosine similarities to three captions are [0.6, 0.4, 0.1], and the first caption is its true partner. Jack lowers the temperature from τ = 1 to τ = 0.1 before the softmax. Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh: 在一个 CLIP 风格的批次中，一张图像与三条说明文字的余弦相似度是 [0.6, 0.4, 0.1]，第一条说明文字是它的真正配对。Jack 在 softmax 之前把温度从 τ = 1 降到 τ = 0.1。下列哪项说法正确？

text.en: The true partner's share rises from about 0.41 to about 0.88, so its loss falls from about 0.89 to about 0.13. Temperature changes how strongly score gaps count.
text.zh: 真正配对所占的份额从约 0.41 升到约 0.88，所以它的损失从约 0.89 降到约 0.13。温度改变的是分数差距的影响力度。

why.en: Right. Dividing by 0.1 turns [0.6, 0.4, 0.1] into [6, 4, 1], so the gaps are ten times larger and softmax concentrates on the highest score.
why.zh: 正确。除以 0.1 把 [0.6, 0.4, 0.1] 变成 [6, 4, 1]，差距扩大了十倍，softmax 就更集中在最高分上。

text.en: Nothing changes, because softmax ignores a change applied to every score.
text.zh: 什么都不会变，因为 softmax 不受施加在所有分数上的变化影响。

why.en: Wrong. Softmax ignores adding the same number to every score, not multiplying every score by 10.
why.zh: 错误。softmax 不受「给每个分数加上同一个数」的影响，但「把每个分数乘以 10」就不同了。

text.en: The true partner's share falls, because dividing by a small number shrinks the scores.
text.zh: 真正配对所占的份额下降，因为除以一个小数会让分数变小。

why.en: Wrong. Dividing by 0.1 multiplies the scores by 10, which enlarges them and their gaps.
why.zh: 错误。除以 0.1 等于把分数乘以 10，分数和它们的差距都会变大。

text.en: The cosine similarities themselves change, because temperature is applied inside the encoders.
text.zh: 余弦相似度本身会改变，因为温度作用在编码器内部。

why.en: Wrong. The encoders' outputs and their cosines stay the same; temperature only rescales the scores before the softmax.
why.zh: 错误。编码器的输出和余弦值都不变；温度只在 softmax 之前缩放分数。

title.en: A question mixes three image regions
title.zh: 一个问题混合三个图像区域

prompt.en:
A question token in Leon's model has query q = (2, 0). Three image regions supply keys and values:

region 1: key (1, 0), value (6, 0)
region 2: key (0, 1), value (0, 6)
region 3: key (1, 1), value (3, 3)

Use scores q·k / √2, a softmax over the three regions, and output = Σ weight × value. What is the first coordinate of the output? Give 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh:
Leon 模型中一个问题词元的查询是 q = (2, 0)。三个图像区域提供键和值：

区域 1：键 (1, 0)，值 (6, 0)
区域 2：键 (0, 1)，值 (0, 6)
区域 3：键 (1, 1)，值 (3, 3)

使用分数 q·k / √2，在三个区域上做 softmax，输出 = Σ 权重 × 值。输出的第一个坐标是多少？保留 3 位小数。

solution.en:
Step 1: scores. q·k₁ = 2, q·k₂ = 0, q·k₃ = 2. Divided by √2 ≈ 1.4142: [1.4142, 0, 1.4142].

Step 2: exponentiate: e^1.4142 ≈ 4.1133, e^0 = 1, e^1.4142 ≈ 4.1133. Sum ≈ 9.2265.
Weights ≈ [0.4458, 0.1084, 0.4458].

Step 3: output.
First coordinate: 0.4458 × 6 + 0.1084 × 0 + 0.4458 × 3 = 2.6748 + 1.3374 ≈ 4.012.
Second coordinate: 0.4458 × 0 + 0.1084 × 6 + 0.4458 × 3 ≈ 0.6504 + 1.3374 ≈ 1.988.

The output (4.012, 1.988) is a blend, not a copy of one region: regions 1 and 3 tie for the highest weight, and region 2 still contributes a little. A different question (a different q) would mix the same values differently. The weights alone do not prove that the final answer is right.

prompt.en:
Emma's search index stores unit image vectors. The unit query vector is [0.6, 0.8]. The images are:

P = [1, 0], Q = [0.8, 0.6], R = [0, 1], S = [0.6, 0.8], U = [0.28, 0.96]

Checked relevance: Q, R and U are relevant; P and S are not. Rank by dot product. What is Recall@3 (relevant items in the top 3 divided by all relevant items)? Give 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh:
Emma 的检索索引存储的是单位长度的图像向量。单位查询向量是 [0.6, 0.8]。图像如下：

P = [1, 0]，Q = [0.8, 0.6]，R = [0, 1]，S = [0.6, 0.8]，U = [0.28, 0.96]

经核对的相关性：Q、R、U 相关；P 和 S 不相关。按点积排序。Recall@3（前 3 名中的相关项数除以全部相关项数）是多少？保留 3 位小数。

solution.en:
Scores (dot products with [0.6, 0.8]):
P: 0.6. Q: 0.48 + 0.48 = 0.96. R: 0.8. S: 0.36 + 0.64 = 1.00. U: 0.168 + 0.768 = 0.936.

Ranking: S (1.00), Q (0.96), U (0.936), R (0.80), P (0.60).

Top 3 = S, Q, U. Relevant among them: Q and U, so 2. All relevant items: 3.
Recall@3 = 2 / 3 ≈ 0.667.

The top result S has a perfect score of 1.00 but is not relevant: a high similarity is not the same as the right object. R, which is relevant, sits just outside the shortlist; a reranker that only sees the top 3 can never recover it. A hit-rate convention ("at least one relevant item in the top 3") would give 1.0 here, so state which definition you use.
solution.zh:
分数（与 [0.6, 0.8] 的点积）：
P：0.6。Q：0.48 + 0.48 = 0.96。R：0.8。S：0.36 + 0.64 = 1.00。U：0.168 + 0.768 = 0.936。

排序：S（1.00）、Q（0.96）、U（0.936）、R（0.80）、P（0.60）。

前 3 名 = S、Q、U。其中相关的有 Q 和 U，共 2 个。全部相关项：3 个。
Recall@3 = 2 / 3 ≈ 0.667。

排名第一的 S 得到满分 1.00，却并不相关：相似度高并不等于找对了物体。相关的 R 恰好落在候选名单之外；只看前 3 名的重排器永远找不回它。如果按「命中率」约定（前 3 名中至少有一个相关项），这里会得到 1.0，所以要说明采用的是哪种定义。

title.en: Mean loss of a checked answer

prompt.en:
Under teacher forcing, Noah's captioning model assigns these probabilities to the four tokens of the checked answer (the last one is the ending token):

0.6, 0.25, 0.8, 0.95

What is the mean per-token loss −(ln p₁ + ln p₂ + ln p₃ + ln p₄) / 4? Give 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh:
在教师强制下，Noah 的图像描述模型给核对答案的四个词元分配了以下概率（最后一个是结束词元）：

0.6、0.25、0.8、0.95

每个词元的平均损失 −(ln p₁ + ln p₂ + ln p₃ + ln p₄) / 4 是多少？保留 3 位小数。

solution.en:
Natural logs: ln 0.6 ≈ −0.5108, ln 0.25 ≈ −1.3863, ln 0.8 ≈ −0.2231, ln 0.95 ≈ −0.0513.

Sum ≈ −2.1716. Negate and divide by 4: 2.1716 / 4 ≈ 0.543.

The whole response has probability 0.6 × 0.25 × 0.8 × 0.95 = 0.114, and −ln 0.114 ≈ 2.1716 is the summed loss. The second token, with probability 0.25, contributes the most. A low loss says the model expects these words; whether the words are true of the image must be checked against the image.
solution.zh:
自然对数：ln 0.6 ≈ −0.5108，ln 0.25 ≈ −1.3863，ln 0.8 ≈ −0.2231，ln 0.95 ≈ −0.0513。

总和 ≈ −2.1716。取相反数再除以 4：2.1716 / 4 ≈ 0.543。

整个回答的概率是 0.6 × 0.25 × 0.8 × 0.95 = 0.114，而 −ln 0.114 ≈ 2.1716 就是总损失。概率为 0.25 的第二个词元贡献最大。损失低只说明模型预料到了这些词；这些词对图像来说是否属实，必须对照图像检查。

prompt.en: Jack wants to know who spoke when in a recorded meeting. His speech-recognition transcript has a word error rate of 0.05. Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh: Jack 想知道一段会议录音中谁在什么时候说话。他的语音识别转写结果的词错误率是 0.05。下列哪项说法正确？

text.en: He needs speaker diarization, which marks speaker turns in time. A low WER says how well the words were written, not who said them.
text.zh: 他需要说话人分离，它在时间轴上标出各个说话人的轮次。WER 低只说明词写得准不准，不说明是谁说的。

why.en: Right. Transcription and diarization are different tasks with different targets. Diarization gives anonymous labels such as speaker A and B, not verified names.
why.zh: 正确。转写和说话人分离是目标不同的两个任务。说话人分离给出的是 A、B 这样的匿名标签，而不是经过核实的姓名。

text.en: A WER of 0.05 means that 95% of the speaker labels are right.
text.zh: WER 为 0.05 意味着 95% 的说话人标签是对的。

why.en: Wrong. WER counts word substitutions, deletions and insertions. It contains no speaker information at all.
why.zh: 错误。WER 统计的是词的替换、删除和插入，其中根本不包含说话人的信息。

text.en: Translating the transcript into another language will reveal the speaker turns.
text.zh: 把转写结果翻译成另一种语言就能显示出说话人的轮次。

why.en: Wrong. Translation changes the language of the words; it does not add who-spoke-when information.
why.zh: 错误。翻译改变的是词的语言，不会增加「谁在何时说话」的信息。

text.en: Sound-event recognition will name each speaker, because each voice is a distinct sound event.
text.zh: 声音事件识别会说出每个说话人的名字，因为每个人的声音都是一个独立的声音事件。

why.en: Wrong. Sound-event recognition labels kinds of sounds, such as a door slam. It does not separate speaker turns or verify identities.
why.zh: 错误。声音事件识别标注的是声音的种类，例如关门声。它不会区分说话人的轮次，也不会核实身份。

title.en: A short event between sampled frames
title.zh: 落在采样帧之间的短暂事件

prompt.en: A 20-second video is sampled at timestamps 0, Δ, 2Δ, … (strictly before 20 s). A brief hand-over happens only from 7.4 s to 8.6 s. Leon compares Δ = 3 s with Δ = 2 s. Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh: 一段 20 秒的视频按时间戳 0、Δ、2Δ……采样（严格早于 20 秒）。一次短暂的传递只发生在 7.4 秒到 8.6 秒之间。Leon 比较 Δ = 3 秒和 Δ = 2 秒。下列哪项说法正确？

text.en: With Δ = 3 s no sampled instant falls inside 7.4–8.6 s, so the model never sees the event; with Δ = 2 s the frame at 8 s does.
text.zh: Δ = 3 秒时，没有任何采样时刻落在 7.4–8.6 秒之内，模型根本看不到这个事件；Δ = 2 秒时，8 秒处的帧会落在其中。

why.en: Right. Δ = 3 gives 0, 3, 6, 9, …, which jumps from 6 to 9. Δ = 2 gives 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, …, and 8 lies inside the event.

text.en: With Δ = 3 s the frame at 9 s shows the event, because it is the nearest sample.
text.zh: Δ = 3 秒时，9 秒处的帧能显示这个事件，因为它是最近的采样。

why.en: Wrong. Nearest is not inside: at 9 s the hand-over has already ended (it stopped at 8.6 s).
why.zh: 错误。最近不等于在其中：到 9 秒时传递已经结束了（它在 8.6 秒结束）。

text.en: Averaging the features of the sampled frames recovers the missed event.
text.zh: 对采样帧的特征取平均，就能找回漏掉的事件。

why.en: Wrong. A model cannot use a frame it was never given. Averaging also throws away order.
why.zh: 错误。模型无法使用从未提供给它的帧。取平均还会丢掉顺序。

text.en: With Δ = 2 s the event is still missed, because 8 s is too close to the end of the event.
text.zh: Δ = 2 秒时仍会漏掉这个事件，因为 8 秒离事件结束太近了。

why.en: Wrong. 7.4 ≤ 8 ≤ 8.6, so the frame at 8 s is inside the event, which is what matters.
why.zh: 错误。7.4 ≤ 8 ≤ 8.6，所以 8 秒处的帧在事件之内，这才是关键。

title.en: What changes in each training stage
title.zh: 每个训练阶段改变了什么

prompt.en: Which description matches the guide's account of the original LLaVA recipe?
prompt.zh: 下列哪项描述与本指南对原始 LLaVA 训练方法的介绍一致？

text.en: Stage 1 trains only the projection connector. Stage 2 (instruction tuning) updates the connector and the language model, while the vision encoder stays frozen.
text.zh: 第 1 阶段只训练投影连接器。第 2 阶段（指令微调）更新连接器和语言模型，而视觉编码器保持冻结。

why.en: Right. The vision encoder is never updated in this recipe; the connector is trained first, then the connector and language model learn from image–request–response examples.
why.zh: 正确。在这种方法中视觉编码器从不更新；先训练连接器，然后连接器和语言模型一起从「图像–请求–回答」样本中学习。

text.en: Both stages update the vision encoder, because instruction tuning must improve perception.
text.zh: 两个阶段都更新视觉编码器，因为指令微调必须提升感知能力。

why.en: Wrong. In the original recipe the vision encoder stays frozen throughout. Instruction tuning teaches response behaviour; it does not by itself fix perception.
why.zh: 错误。在原始方法中，视觉编码器自始至终保持冻结。指令微调教的是回答方式，它本身并不能修正感知。

text.en: A small Q-Former learns to query a frozen image encoder and connect it to a frozen language model.
text.zh: 一个小型 Q-Former 学习查询冻结的图像编码器，并把它连接到冻结的语言模型。

why.en: Wrong. That describes BLIP-2's pretraining recipe, a different historical design.
why.zh: 错误。那描述的是 BLIP-2 的预训练方法，是另一种历史上的设计。

text.en: Only the language model is trained; no connector is needed because image features are already text.
text.zh: 只训练语言模型；不需要连接器，因为图像特征本来就是文本。

why.en: Wrong. Image features and text features are different numerical formats; the connector translates between them.
why.zh: 错误。图像特征和文本特征是不同的数值格式；连接器负责在两者之间转换。

title.zh: 幻觉更少，覆盖率也更低

prompt.en:
Noah audits two caption sets for the same 20 photos, which contain 80 annotated target objects in total.

Set X: 50 object mentions, 5 unsupported, found in 4 captions; the other 45 mentions are distinct correct targets.
Set Y: 20 object mentions, 1 unsupported, in 1 caption; the other 19 are distinct correct targets.

Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh:
Noah 审核同一组 20 张照片的两套图像描述，这些照片共有 80 个标注的目标物体。

X 组：50 次物体提及，其中 5 次没有依据，分布在 4 条描述中；其余 45 次提及是互不重复的正确目标。
Y 组：20 次物体提及，其中 1 次没有依据，在 1 条描述中；其余 19 次是互不重复的正确目标。

下列哪项说法正确？

text.en: Y has the lower instance-level CHAIR (0.05 against 0.10) but much lower coverage (0.24 against 0.56). Neither set is better on every measure.
text.zh: Y 的实例级 CHAIR 更低（0.05 对 0.10），但覆盖率也低得多（0.24 对 0.56）。没有哪一组在所有指标上都更好。

why.en: Right. CHAIRᵢ: X 5/50 = 0.10, Y 1/20 = 0.05. Coverage: X 45/80 ≈ 0.56, Y 19/80 ≈ 0.24. Saying less avoids errors but also omits useful facts.
why.zh: 正确。CHAIRᵢ：X 为 5/50 = 0.10，Y 为 1/20 = 0.05。覆盖率：X 为 45/80 ≈ 0.56，Y 为 19/80 ≈ 0.24。说得少能避免错误，但也漏掉了有用的事实。

text.en: Y is better on every measure, because it invents fewer objects.
text.zh: Y 在每个指标上都更好，因为它编造的物体更少。

why.en: Wrong. Y's coverage is far lower: it mentions only 19 of the 80 target objects.
why.zh: 错误。Y 的覆盖率低得多：80 个目标物体中它只提到了 19 个。

text.en: X's sentence-level CHAIR is 5/20 = 0.25.
text.zh: X 的句子级 CHAIR 是 5/20 = 0.25。

why.en: Wrong. Sentence level counts captions with at least one error: 4 of 20, so 0.20. The 5 is a count of mentions.
why.zh: 错误。句子级统计的是至少含一个错误的描述条数：20 条中有 4 条，所以是 0.20。5 是提及的次数。

text.en: X has the lower instance-level CHAIR, because it mentions more correct objects.
text.zh: X 的实例级 CHAIR 更低，因为它提到的正确物体更多。

why.en: Wrong. CHAIRᵢ is the unsupported share of mentions: 0.10 for X is higher than 0.05 for Y. More correct mentions raise coverage, not this score.
why.zh: 错误。CHAIRᵢ 是无依据提及所占的比例：X 的 0.10 高于 Y 的 0.05。正确提及多会提高覆盖率，而不是降低这个分数。

title.en: Toy cost saving of a two-stage cascade
title.zh: 两阶段级联的玩具成本节省

prompt.en:
Jack's archive helper has N = 400 candidate pages. A cheap retrieval pass costs 0.5 units per page; the detailed reader costs 8 units per page. The cascade runs the cheap pass on every page and the detailed reader on the top k = 20 only.

Using full_cost = N × expensive_cost and cascade_cost = N × cheap_cost + k × expensive_cost, what fraction of the toy cost does the cascade save? Give 4 decimal places.
prompt.zh:
Jack 的档案助手有 N = 400 个候选页面。便宜的检索阶段每页花费 0.5 个单位；精细阅读器每页花费 8 个单位。级联对每一页都运行便宜阶段，但只对前 k = 20 页运行精细阅读器。

使用 full_cost = N × expensive_cost 和 cascade_cost = N × cheap_cost + k × expensive_cost，级联节省了多大比例的玩具成本？保留 4 位小数。

solution.en:
Full cost: 400 × 8 = 3200 units.
Cascade cost: 400 × 0.5 + 20 × 8 = 200 + 160 = 360 units.
Saved fraction = 1 − 360 / 3200 = 1 − 0.1125 = 0.8875.

So the cascade does 88.75% less toy work. That saving is worth having only if the shortlist keeps the evidence: if the page a question needs is ranked 25th by the cheap pass, the detailed reader never sees it and the answer must fail or abstain. Measure retrieval recall at k = 20 on checked questions before trusting the speed-up, and remember that this arithmetic ignores overheads and parallel hardware.
solution.zh:
完整成本：400 × 8 = 3200 个单位。
级联成本：400 × 0.5 + 20 × 8 = 200 + 160 = 360 个单位。
节省比例 = 1 − 360 / 3200 = 1 − 0.1125 = 0.8875。

所以级联少做了 88.75% 的玩具工作量。只有当候选名单保留了证据时，这种节省才有价值：如果某个问题需要的页面在便宜阶段排在第 25 名，精细阅读器就永远看不到它，回答只能失败或拒答。在信任这种加速之前，要在核对过的问题上测量 k = 20 时的检索召回率；还要记住，这个算式忽略了额外开销和并行硬件。
